The run proved nothing.\033[0m"; else PYTHONPATH=. python -m mutmut results > .reports/mutation_survivors.txt 2>&1; S=$(grep -c ': survived' .reports/mutation_survivors.txt); echo -e "\033[1;32m✔  Mutation Check: complete — $S survivor(s), see .reports/mutation_survivors.txt\033[0m"; fi
